# Import fixtures

Generated by `make-fixtures.sh` (needs `ffmpeg`; invented content only) and committed, so tests
do not need to run the script. Re-running keeps existing files; `FORCE=1` regenerates them
(Ogg/WebM output differs byte-wise between runs, which is why files are not rewritten).
Total size about 850 KB.

| File | What |
|---|---|
| `tagged.mp3` | 5 s; title "Glass Harbour", artist "The Example Band", album "Test Pressings", date 2021-03-04, composer "Ann Example; Bo Sample", copyright "(c) 2021 The Example Band" |
| `tagged.ogg` | same tags as Vorbis stream tags |
| `untagged.flac` | 5 s, mono 8 kHz, no tags |
| `with-audio.mp4` | 2 s test video + sine, title "Clip Title" |
| `no-audio.mp4` | 2 s test video, no audio stream |
| `not-audio.mp3` | a text file with an mp3 name |
| `download.webm`, `info.json` | what the fake yt-dlp "downloads" (Opus 5 s; title "The Example Band - Night Drive", `https://media.example/watch?v=abc123`, upload_date 20200115) |
| `stems/{vocals,drums,bass,guitar,piano,other}.flac` | 16 s, mono 8 kHz, different tones (used by the stub separator; 16 s audible each) |
| `stems-quiet/{silent,minus60,minus45}.flac` | 1 s, mono 8 kHz, 16-bit: digital silence, a 440 Hz sine at about -60 dBFS, and one at about -45 dBFS (used by the stub separator's `sparse` and `silent` modes). These are all empty under the 15 s rule. |
| `stems-activity/` | mono 8 kHz 16-bit tones gated on whole 100 ms windows, for the audible-time rule: `bursts.flac` (30 s, 9 500 ms audible, peak -8.0 dBFS: a 9 s burst at -17 dBFS plus five one-sample clicks; empty), `phrases.flac` (32 s, 16 000 ms audible, peak -20.0 dBFS: eight 2 s phrases with 2 s gaps; kept), `audible-14900ms.flac` (20 s, 14 900 ms, -20.0 dBFS; empty), `audible-15000ms.flac` (20 s, 15 000 ms, -20.0 dBFS; kept) |
| `long.flac` | 16 min (960 s) of silence, mono 8 kHz, about 100 KB (FLAC compresses silence); committed, not generated at test time |
| `not-flac.flac` | an Ogg file with a .flac name |

The editor test repository (`../library-editor/`) is generated by `../editor/make-fixtures.sh`; it reuses `tagged.mp3` and `stems/` from here. Regenerating `../library-editor/` with `FORCE=1` would copy the 16 s stems.
